flashcards.question: Mɔgɔ jumɛn ye Test Turing hakilina?
San jumɛn na 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' sɛbɛnna?
Ɲininkali jugu min Turing ye ɲɛnabɔ?
options: Yala masinw bɛ se ka pan?
Yala masinw bɛ se ka miiri?
Yala masinw bɛ se ka dusu?
flashcards.source: [00:17] - 'ɲininkali ba: yala masinw bɛ se ka miiri'

flashcards.question: Test Turing ye mun ye?
options: Mɔgɔ dɔ bɛ kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛ ni mɔgɔ ni masin ye
Ka échecs tulonkɛ ni ɔridinatɛri ye
flashcards.source: [00:27] - 'Mɔgɔ dɔ b'a hakili la k'a kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛ...'

flashcards.question: Yala Test Turing bɛ a lajɛ wa masin bɛ dusu?
options: Ayi, a b'a lajɛ wa a bɛ se ka mɔgɔ jaabi lase
flashcards.source: [00:41] - 'Tɛ a lajɛ wa masin... bɛ dusu...'
